ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A $3 \times 3 \times 3$ cube is made up of small $1 \times 1 \times 1$ cubes. Then the middle cubes from front to back, from top to bottom and from right to left are removed (see diagram). How many $1 \times 1 \times 1$ - cubes remain?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a 3×3×3 large cube composed of unit small cubes. There is a hole at the position of the small square in the center of the front face, and an opening can also be seen in the center of the top; the figure also shows mutually perpendicular middle channels passing through the center of the cube, consistent with the statement that the small cubes on the three center lines from front to back, from top to bottom, and from right to left are removed. Reasoning: The original 3×3×3 cube has a total of 27 1×1×1 small cubes. What is removed is three straight lines passing through the center, and each straight line contains 3 small cubes, so directly adding gives 3+3+3=9. The three lines all intersect only at the very central small cube; this central small cube is counted 3 times in the count of 9, but actually should only be counted 1 time, so 2 extra times must be subtracted. The number of removed small cubes is 9−2=7. The number of remaining small cubes is 27−7=20.

method.method_draft: Use inclusion-exclusion on the removed middle lines. First describe the diagram: it shows a 3-by-3-by-3 block of unit cubes with a tunnel through the center of the front face, an opening through the center of the top face, and the corresponding middle passage across the cube, indicating three perpendicular central lines of cubes have been removed. From the text, read that the original cube has 3×3×3=27 unit cubes and that the removed sets are the middle cubes front-to-back, top-to-bottom, and right-to-left. Each removed line contains 3 cubes. The three lines all intersect only in the central cube, so their union has 3+3+3−2=7 cubes, equivalently 1 center cube plus 6 arm cubes. Subtract removed cubes from the original: 27−7=20.
